commit.message:
Retire TypeScript 5 from the root workspace and require the TypeScript 7 CLI [root-ts7-qualify]

Pin all 21 workspace manifests to TypeScript 7.0.2, preserve project output layouts, and replace the removed compiler API with a bounded synchronous CLI adapter. Require TypeScript 7 in remaining selfhost launchers.

Run one scoped cloud gate and retain the actual npm-generated lock, installed profile, adapter contract, package tests, integration and architecture results. PSC0 qualification and selected seed identity are separate.

Retire TypeScript 5 from the root workspace and require the TypeScript 7 CLI [root-ts7-qualify]

Pin all 21 workspace manifests to TypeScript 7.0.2, preserve project output layouts, and replace the removed compiler API with a bounded synchronous CLI adapter. Require TypeScript 7 in remaining selfhost launchers.

Run one scoped cloud gate and retain the actual npm-generated lock, installed profile, adapter contract, package tests, integration and architecture results. PSC0 qualification and selected seed identity are separate.

Accept valid TypeScript 7 map footer endings and retain the actual npm lock [root-ts7-qualify]

Keep the exact source-map URI assertion while permitting an EOF footer, LF, or CRLF, matching the adapter's existing contract. All source-map, import, diagnostic, refusal and cleanup obligations are unchanged.

Retain the exact 21,592-byte npm-generated lock from run 37949490366, SHA-256 69c5e49b040ff3d45909e15cf1e2123af39fa223b00a7241b533c022a49e33e1. That run passed resolution, clean TypeScript 7 installation, installed profile and root build, then stopped at the new test's trailing-newline assumption. The next gate uses npm ci directly.

Correct the Lean exporter subprocess type for its existing ignored stdin [root-ts7-qualify]

Declare the actual ChildProcessByStdio<null, Readable, Readable> result of stdio ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']. Its three consumers use the existing piped stdout/stderr and process events; no executable statement, provider behavior, cast, or compiler option changes.

Root run 37950075083 passed clean TS7 installation, the root build, complete ordered package tests including all 11 adapter obligations, and the conformance package build. The newly included lean4export build exposed this previously inconsistent declaration.

Reconcile compiler source inventory and enforce exact package language metadata [root-ts7-qualify]

Preserve the compiler manifest's actual paired TypeScript/Lean/ProofScript bootstrap source inventory in the package map. Name the active TypeScript 7.0.2 CLI in the host pipeline. Require exact nonempty source-language agreement for every outer package while retaining all graph, status, source-shape, editor and architecture checks.

Run 37950522687 passed all builds, package tests, all 11 TS7 adapter obligations and package integration before exposing this existing metadata mismatch. A complete static review of the remaining map/architecture rules, all 178 scoped TypeScript files and 10 editor inputs found no further violations. No native bootstrap, provider or kernel behavior is changed.
